comment_regular: TES4 authoritative shared character-state velocity solver. Input block is eight hkVector4-sized slots: +0x00 response scalar x, +0x10 basis vector A, +0x20 basis vector B, +0x30 solver up/third basis, +0x40 current velocity, +0x50 desired local velocity, +0x60 max local delta x, +0x70 reference/bias velocity. Output writes the solved world/Havok velocity to the second argument.
